chunks: Al-Yasaʿ ibn ʿAbdullah al-Qummī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man praying over the funeral alone. He said:
I said: “Then if two pray over it?” He said: “Yes, but one should stand behind the other and not stand beside him.”

key_terms.ٱلْجِنَازَةِ: the funeral or deceased over whom the prayer is performed

ai.seo_question: Can one person perform the funeral prayer alone, and how should two people stand for it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding salat over the deceased. It permits funeral prayer by one person alone, and if two people perform it, one should stand behind the other rather than side by side.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.477 - Al-Yasa' ibn Abdullah al-Qummi asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a man praying over a funeral alone.
Imam (as) replied: "Yes, he may do so."

I then asked: "What if there are two people praying?"
The Imam said: "Yes, but one should stand behind the other, not next to him."
